<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex41012025-05-0612-52-43" status="finalized"><milestone n="gzhan lugs dgag pa" unit="section"/>dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs> na re brjod bya bden pa yod par bstan pas bden rtogs kyi dgos pa <expan>med</expan> pa'i log rtogs khyegs la | <expan>de dgos</expan> pa bstan pas sgrub mi nus pa'i
				<lb n="5b4"/> log rtogs khyegs so zhes zer ba ni ma yin te | brjod bya bden pa yod par bstan pas de nyid <expan>med</expan> pa'i log rtogs khegs kyang de rtogs dgos pa <expan>med</expan> pa'i log rtogs mi khegs te | brjod bya bden pa yod pa la de rtogs pas ma khyab pa'i phyir shing yod par bstan pas sha pa <expan>med</expan> pa'i log rtogs mi khegs pa'i <expan>bzhin no</expan> ||
				 yang dgos pa bstan pas de nyid <expan>med</expan> pa'i log rtogs khegs kyang sgrub mi nus pa'i
				<lb n="5b5"/> log rtogs mi khyegs te | dgos pa yod pa la sgrub nus pas ma khyab pa'i phyir 'jog po'i nor bu <expan> bzhin no</expan>|| </seg></TEI>
